AGENDA
PLANNING COMMISSION
MEETING
Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at (310) 378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
Any person who has made campaign contributions to any of the members of the Planning Commission within twelve months before this meeting, should examine the provisions of Government Code Section 84308 which is posted on the bulletin board outside the Council Chamber.
We are advised by the members of the Commission that none of them have received campaign contributions within the last twelve months.
The applicant or any property owner entitled to notice of the hearing may, within fifteen days after the date of the Planning Commission decision, appeal the Planning Commission decision to the City Council (Ord. No. 091-529). A fee is required for filing an appeal with the City Clerkâ€™s office (R05-14).
The Council may, within fifteen days after the date of the decision or on or before the first date following the first Council meeting after the date of the Planning Commission decision, whichever occurs last: 1) Confirm the action of the Planning Commission and grant or deny the application; 2) Set the matter for public hearing and dispose of it in the same manner as on an appeal; or 3) Amend, modify, delete or add any condition of approval which the Council finds is not substantial under the circumstances relative to or affecting the property subject to the application for a development entitlement. Any determination of the Council pursuant to this paragraph shall be conclusive and final.
The Planning Commission reserves the right to modify the order of items shown on the agenda and advises all interested parties to arrive promptly at the commencement of the meeting.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

Present: Thomas, Chang, Lazzaro, Criley, Walker
Absent: None
Also Present: Assistant City Attorney Cotti, Deputy City Manager/Building & Planning
Director Repp-Loadsman, City Planner Corpuz

  2128 Via Pacheco
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

  Action: Commissioner Chang moved and Commissioner Criley seconded to approve the

2.  M-1251/M-1252-18; Consideration of Miscellaneous Applications for after-the-fact
  approval for walls exceeding the allowable height & non-standard encroachments within the

  Appellant:  Mel Masuda
  1809 Via Arriba
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
  Applicant:  Thomas G. Dobos
  600 Tularosa
  Irvine, CA 92618
  Owner:  Jay & Anna Yamamoto

  Speakers: Allan Rigg, Tom Dobos, Mel Masuda, Jay Yamamoto
  Action: Commissioner Lazzaro moved and Commissioner Criley seconded to deny the
  appeal (5-0, in favor) and uphold the Director’s determination to approve the Minor
  Modification application, as modified.

Planning Commission  2  Director  SR-L
Action Minutes
March 20, 2018
 5.  NC-1617-18; Consideration of a Neighborhood Compatibility Application for a new second
  story deck at the single family residence located at 729 Via Del Monte. Lot 3, Block 1535,
  Tract 6884. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code
  Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant:  Mark Scott Associates
  2022 Orchard Dr.
  Newport Beach, CA 92660
  Owner:  Eric & Amanda Arosemena

  Speakers: Allan Rigg, Gregory Schroff
  Action: Commissioner Walker moved and Commissioner Criley seconded to approve the
  application (5-0, in favor) with standard conditions and the following additional conditions:
  1) The number of posts supporting the deck shall be reduced to 3 posts; and 2) The trellis
  above a portion of the first floor deck shall be removed.

6.  NC-1619/G-1614-18; Consideration of Neighborhood Compatibility & Grading
  Applications for a new single family residence located at 932 Paseo La Cresta. Lot 16,
  Tract 31329. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative
  Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant:  Tomaro Architecture
  2617 N. Sepulveda Blvd., #100
  Manhattan Beach, CA 90266
  Owner:  Jinfeng Yang & Jing Jia

  Speakers: Louie Tomaro, Tommy Tong, Sangita Mody
  Action: Commissioner Walker moved and Commissioner Criley seconded to approve the
  applications (5-0, in favor) with standard conditions and the following additional conditions:
  1) A 10-foot wide public sewer line runs on the property alongside and parallel to the
  southerly property line. The developer shall determine the actual location, alignment and
  condition of the sewer mainline, confirmed by video surveillance and report. Easements
  shall be shown on the plan. If the sewer is found to not lie within the existing easement, a
  new easement shall be dedicated and existing easement vacated; legal description and
  easement deeds shall be prepared by a licensed land surveyor with costs and applicable fees
  paid by the applicant. No object, whether a permanent structure, or a temporary structure, or
  any object which is difficult to remove are allowed within sewer easements. Any grading
  within the sewer easement shall be approved prior to issuance of any building permits; 2)
  The project creates, adds or replaces more than 10,000 square feet of impervious surface and
  portions of the lot being graded/excavated exceed 25% grade; thus, the project shall comply
  with the City’s municipal NPDES permit and requirements set forth in Municipal Code
  13.08.060, Section C; 3) Damaged curb and gutter, including by existing trees or proposed
  construction, shall be removed and replaced per the City Engineer; 4) Reconstruct the
  existing driveway in accordance with City standards; 5) Additional landscaping shall be
  planted to help screen the existing retaining wall at the rear of the property subject to
  approval of a landscape plan; 6) The dining room chimney shall be removed; 7) The
  southeast chimney of the great room shall be lowered to the height of the adjacent ridgeline;

Planning Commission  3  Director  SR-L
Action Minutes
March 20, 2018
   8) A hedge along the west side property line shall be included to enhance privacy with the
  adjacent neighbor at 936 Paseo La Cresta; and 9) The master bedroom windows shall be
  reduced to 4’-6”.

NEW BUSINESS

7.  NC-1620/G-1615/SC-138/M-1255-18; Consideration of Neighborhood Compatibility,
  Grading, Sports Court & Miscellaneous Applications for a new single family residence,
  sports court & walls exceeding the allowable height located at 1201 Granvia Altamira. Lot
  1, Block 4, Tract 7538 & portion of Lot E, Tract 8652. This project is exempt from CEQA
  pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant:  Jeffrey Dahl
  1102 Main St.
  Huntington Beach, CA 92648
  Owner:  Sahil Sharma

  Speakers: Jeffrey Dahl, Gordon Tsui
  Continued to the April meeting.

8.  M-1249-18; Consideration of a Miscellaneous Application for fencing exceeding the
  allowable height within the setback adjacent to the street at the single family residence
  located at 3901 Palos Verdes Drive North. Lot 6, Tract 17901. This project is exempt
  from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant/Owner:  David & Jennifer Bray

  Speakers: David Bray
  Action: Commissioner Walker moved and Commissioner Lazzaro seconded to approve the
  application (5-0, in favor) with standard conditions and the following additional conditions:
  1) Hedges that lie within public right-of-way shall be removed and plantings within the
  right-of-way shall not be taller than 30 inches; and 2) The proposed 6 ft. high fence is
  approved in concept. The applicant shall come back to the Planning Commission with the
  final fence and landscape plan for final approval.

Planning Commission  4  Director  SR-L
Action Minutes
March 20, 2018
   ITEMS OF INFORMATION

9.  Conditional Use Permit Annual Review

  The Commission directed staff to: 1) work with the business owners of the 3 businesses that
  are out of compliance with the approved CUP to come into compliance or obtain approval;
  2) allow the remaining CUPs to continue without modification; and 3) recommend to the
  City Council to consider an ordinance amendment related to modifying conditional use
  permits and establishing a fee for the annual review.

10.  Minor Modifications. – Reviewed & filed

11.  Art Jury Meeting Schedule. – Reviewed & filed

12.  A.  City Council Actions of February 27, 2018

  a. Adoption of Water Efficient Landscape Ordinance – deferred with instruction to
  staff to evaluate if a project includes both public and private property within the
  scope and calculations. The concern is related to properties with large parkways.

  B.  City Council Actions of March 13, 2018
  a. Presentation and Discussion of Matrix Report of Non-Safety City Functions (view
  here)
  b. Appeal of NC-1601-17 for new single-family home at 701 Mexico Place (view
  here)

  Note: City Council was divided and continued the public hearing to March 27, 2018
  to allow the applicant to consider view impacts to the Danna property.

  c. Ordinance establishing Technology Advisory Committee (view here)

ACTION MINUTES

13.  Meeting of February 20, 2018.

Action: Commissioner Criley and Commissioner Lazzaro  seconded to approve the minutes as
written (5-0, in favor).

Adjourn to the Joint Meeting of City Council/Planning Commission on Tuesday, March 27,
2018 at 5:30PM

Adjourn to the Planning Commission meeting on Tuesday, April 17, 2018 at 6:30 PM

Adjourned at 9:42 pm.
